description:
Navigate to the inventory management section of NCH Copper Point of Sale. First, create a new inventory item with the following details:
- Item Code/Name: 'Crystal Wine Decanter'
- Description: '750ml Lead-Free Crystal Decanter'
- Unit Cost: 25.00
- Unit Sales Price: 45.00
- Initial Quantity: 12

After creating the item, perform a stock quantity adjustment (shrinkage) for this specific item:
- Adjust quantity by: -3 (to reflect broken items)
- Reason/Note: 'Shipping Damage'

The final quantity should be 9. Verify the adjustment is saved.
